Brick-MapProtect

About

I'm a sixth-form computer science student in Wolverhampton and the owner of Brickworks Network. Most of what I know started with wanting my own Minecraft server to run well, which pulled me into plugins, Linux, Docker and networking.

I like building the systems behind a community as much as the community itself: the plugin that stops griefing, the panel that shows a server's health, the small tools that make running everything a little easier.

Right now I'm deepening my Java and picking up web development, so this site, hand-built with no framework, is part of the practice.

Let's build something worth logging in for.

Server development, a plugin, content, or a collaboration. I'm happy to talk.
